what: Two rings of dots (.82 and .77 of the diameter, 57 dots per ring at .11 radian spacing — with a few gaps) stand in the middle of a canvas panel painted in the accent color. Each dot has a 1.5% chance per frame of becoming ”growing”, grows by 0~.47px per frame up to 10px, then shrinks to 2px and returns to place, twinkling (a night-sky ring of starlight). When fx:swap arrives on the element, the ring spins out hidden at .7x · -70° in .5s and returns the same way after .7s — a hero where the ring spins back in every time the slide changes

options.size: Size inside the canvas, width x height, default 1075x1100 — on screen it stretches to the element width
options.rings: Ring diameter ratios (multiplied by half the canvas width), comma-separated, default 0.82,0.77
options.gaps1: First ring gaps — dot index ratio ranges ‹a-b› separated by commas, default 0.1875-0.3125,0.5625-0.6875
options.small: Smallest radius (px), default 2 — initial size is between small and small+4
options.back: Time (ms) until returning after fx:swap, default 700
options.--fx-dur: Hide and return duration (css variable), default .5s
options.--fx-top: Vertical position of the canvas center (css variable), default 50% — original calc(50% - 190px)
options.--fx-dot-1~4: Four dot colors (css variables) — default is --kf-accent-soft mixed with white and the accent color
options.fx:swap: Hover the element and the ring spins away, then returns

from.where: index.html .ks-kv__bg (original .top_kv_bg canvas.canvas01 — 1075×1100, 114 dots with a size play through the classes ‹base→big→small›, background #0776ae repainted every frame, .hidden on Swiper slideChangeTransitionStart{opacity:0;scale(.7) rotate(-70deg)} .5s → removed after 700ms)

note: The original picks the dot color at random from four, #07ffff · #08a7f0 · #08d9fd · #07e6ff — here, four mixes of the skin’s teal (--kf-accent-soft) with white and the accent color. The original leftMouse does not change from the center at first, so it does not react to the cursor
